**Purpose:** Supplemental Figure 9.
Extracted and reorganized from `revision3/R03_mito_reconciliation.Rmd`.

**S9 Fig:** Mean log2(SILAC ratio) of mitochondrial proteins during carbon starvation,
separated by subcompartment (Matrix/IM, IMS/IM, OM) using the Morgenstern 2017
high-confidence mitochondrial proteome as reference.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/master_tidy_protein.csv`
- `data/mitochondrial proteome/mmc4.xlsx` (Morgenstern 2017 — local only)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("sfig/SFig_9.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(cowplot)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)

out_dir  <- "sfig/plots"
data_dir <- "sfig/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
prot     <- read_csv("./tables/master_tidy_protein.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
mito_dir <- "./data/mitochondrial proteome/"

mito_ref_path <- file.path(mito_dir, "mmc4.xlsx")
if (!file.exists(mito_ref_path)) {
  stop("Morgenstern 2017 reference file not found: ", mito_ref_path,
       "\nThis file is stored locally (not tracked in git).")
}
```

```{r mito-reference}
mito_ref <- read_excel(mito_ref_path,
                       sheet = "High-confidence mito. proteome") %>%
  transmute(
    orf         = `Gene Systematic Name`,
    uniprot     = `UniProt ID`,
    gene        = `Gene Standard Name1`,
    description = `Gene Description`,
    subloc_raw  = `Submitochondrial Localization2`,
    subloc = case_when(
      grepl("Matrix", subloc_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Matrix/IM",
      grepl("IMS",    subloc_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "IMS/IM",
      grepl("OM",     subloc_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "OM",
      TRUE ~ "Unassigned"
    )
  )
```

```{r join-proteins}
id_col   <- grep("Protein", names(prot), value = TRUE)[1]
prot_mito <- prot %>%
  mutate(leading_acc = sub(";.*$", "", .data[[id_col]])) %>%
  inner_join(mito_ref %>% dplyr::select(uniprot, gene, subloc),
             by = c("leading_acc" = "uniprot"))
```

---

## S9 — Mean log2(rim15Δ/WT) by subcompartment during carbon starvation

```{r s9-plot}
subloc_traj <- prot_mito %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(normalized_ratio),
                nutrient == "C",
                genotype != "spike-in") %>%
  group_by(leading_acc, gene, subloc, samplingTime) %>%
  summarise(mean_ratio = mean(normalized_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subloc, samplingTime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2fc = mean(mean_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_log2fc  = sd(mean_ratio,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(mean_ratio))),
    n_proteins  = sum(!is.na(mean_ratio)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(time_h = as.integer(sub("T", "", samplingTime)),
         subloc = factor(subloc,
                         levels = c("Matrix/IM", "IMS/IM", "OM", "Unassigned")))

subloc_colors <- c("Matrix/IM"  = "#4C96D7",
                   "IMS/IM"     = "#82C341",
                   "OM"         = "#F5A623",
                   "Unassigned" = "#9B9B9B")

p_S9 <- ggplot(subloc_traj,
               aes(x = time_h, y = mean_log2fc,
                   color = subloc, group = subloc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_log2fc - sem_log2fc,
                    ymax = mean_log2fc + sem_log2fc),
                width = 1, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subloc_colors, name = "Subcompartment") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 30)) +
  labs(x     = "Time (h)",
       y     = expression(log[2](rim15*Delta/WT) * " (mean ± SEM across proteins)"),
       title = "Mitochondrial proteins by subcompartment — carbon starvation") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "right")

p_S9
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig9_mito_subcompartment_carbon.pdf"),
       p_S9, width = 7, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)

write_csv(subloc_traj, file.path(data_dir, "SFig9_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig9: ", nrow(subloc_traj), " rows exported")
```
